name: c01_preview_p15
long_context_execution: all arms: memory-linear GLOBAL causal / LOCAL sliding prefill via the 64-row kernel, elided O(n^2) prefill mask mapping, token-chunked MoE (V27_PREFILL_DENSE64=1); canvas calls follow each arm | decoding substrate piecewise_v1 (torch 2.12.1 grouped_mm MoE; decoder compiled reduce-overhead, split at GLOBAL attention which runs eager; LOCAL attention graphed unless the arm routes LOCAL layers; official-style compiled sampler); untimed per-arm warm-up before timed requests
selection_rule: P15 accuracy-first preview of observe_carried (c01, 2026-10-02): the observation call (canvas call 1) forms its output from the FA4 block-sparse kernel on the map call 0 used (the carried map), while the fused kernel runs observation-only (no V load, no PV), so the risk table and every later decision are those of the dense observation. Stacked on M3 R6 DP -ln2 + carry_first + q64c. Small subset first (AIME26 10 problems, LongBench-v2 32K/64K 8 items, 96K 4 items x seeds 404, 505) against dense FA4 all-kept and the same pipeline without c01; mpk and dlm2, one host per cell; substrate piecewise_v5; frozen before generation.
